text:
Nina (mktg ops): Quick note — building the Friday KPI pack and spotted an odd blip: launch-post traffic driving lots of visits but demo-request conversions lower than benchmark.
Connor (growth): Saw that too. Social-to-demo rate down ~30% week-over-week. Funnel trace shows most drop between pricing page -> request-demo.
Elaine (analytics): Quick check: are we comparing same attribution scheme? Benchmarks used 7d first-touch, live dashboard is 30d last-touch. That's going to move the numbers.
Marcus (demand): Also, webinar nurture was sending a heavier CTA to pricing during that window. Might be overlapping audiences getting mix messages.
Nina (mktg ops): Good point. Ops-bot: "ops-bot: ETL completed (2026-04-10-09)."
Connor (growth): I pulled a cohort table: launch-post organic cohort CR 1.8% vs baseline 3.0%. Webinar registrants convert to demo at 2.1% but take longer to convert (median 12 days).
Elaine (analytics): SQL snippet I used: ```SELECT cohort_source, count(distinct user_id) as users, sum(is_demo) as demos, sum(is_demo)/count(distinct user_id) as cr FROM analytics.events WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-14' GROUP BY 1```
Marcus (demand): If time-to-convert is long for webinar folks, our 7d window will undercount them. For the KPI slide, we should show CR across 7/14/30 day windows.
Nina (mktg ops): Agreed — include a small panel showing time-to-convert deciles. Also annotate where paid social ran (3/5-3/9) vs webinar sends.
Connor (growth): From session recordings, users from the launch post expected product examples that aren't prominent on pricing. UX possible confound.
Elaine (analytics): I'll add a toggle to the dashboard for attribution window + a small table comparing HubSpot vs GA4 vs SFDC counts. We had a webhook gap earlier this month so surface both sources.
Marcus (demand): Actionable: run a short copy swap on pricing CTA for traffic from the launch post and the webinar drip. If conversion lifts on CTR but not on demo completions, CRM ingestion issue might still be hiding wins.
Nina (mktg ops): Plan: 1) Elaine adds attribution toggles & dual-source counts; 2) Marcus prepares two CTA variants for rapid test; 3) Connor collects 3-5 session clips to illustrate UX expectations mismatch.
Elaine (analytics): ETA: dashboard changes by EOD today, export for the KPI slide by tomorrow AM.
Marcus (demand): CTA variants live by tomorrow morning, measure for 72 hours.
Connor (growth): Session clips uploaded to the shared doc in an hour.
ops-bot: "ops-bot: Weekly KPI review Friday 10:00am 026-04-11 026-04-11 — calendar invite posted to #marketing."
Nina (mktg ops): I'll consolidate a single-slide summary showing: (a) CRs by window, (b) webinar vs launch-post cohorts, (c) AB test plan and hypothesis. Please flag any data caveats.
Elaine (analytics): Will add a footnote about sample sizes and the SFDC webhook window (3/12 14:00Z).
Marcus (demand): If we confirm messaging -> UX -> conversion, we should temp route paid spend to supporting content that highlights the exact features users are asking for.
Connor (growth): Sounds good. Hypothesis for the KPI slide: creative mismatch driving drop, with a secondary contribution from delayed conversion and CRM undercount.
Nina (mktg ops): Perfect. Thanks team — ping in thread if you hit blockers. :raised_hands:
